process_area.title: Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC

fields.Trigger: Release of import shipment from Bureau of Customs (BOC)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-collect of "Collect Official Receipts" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "recorded for BIR credit" (replaces manual Step 4).
- System auto-flag for investigation of "Investigate significant variances in tariff classification or valuation" (replaces manual Step 5).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
- operational: periodic reconciliation against source documents
Pain Points / Risks: - BOC tariff classification disputes — reclassification can add 5-15% duty differential; appeals process takes 6-12 months
- BIR VAT input credit rejected if BCOR/SSDT documentation is incomplete or mismatched
- Foreign exchange rate fluctuations between BOC assessment date and actual payment date causing landed cost variances
- Customs Broker errors in HS code classification leading to penalties or delayed cargo release
- Port congestion and demurrage fees compounding costs (W249)
- BOC valuation challenges on transfer-priced goods between BuildRight entities
Staffing Implication: 20-30 import shipments/month × ~2 days of reconciliation per shipment = ~40–60 person-days/month. 1 Import Coordinator full-time + 1 Tax Manager part-time (~20% of capacity). Finance support for payment processing absorbed by existing AP team.
System Touchpoints: - BOC e2m Customs system integration for assessment download
- Landed cost calculation engine (W2B) for estimated vs. actual comparison
- AP module for duty payment processing (W7)
- Bank payment portal (IPAY/Pass5) for BOC settlement
- Import PO tracking (W2B) for shipment linkage
Time Estimate: **Total**: 2-3 business days per import shipment (1 day payment + 2 days receipt/reconciliation; variance analysis adds 2 hours if triggered)

steps.activity: **Payment**: Pay duties and taxes via bank (IPAY/Pass5 system) based on BOC assessment
**Receipt Aggregation**: Collect Official Receipts (BCOR) and Statement of Settlement of Duties and Taxes (SSDT)
**Reconciliation**: Compare BOC assessed values vs. ERP estimated landed cost (W2B.12)
**VAT Input Capture**: Ensure 12% Import VAT is correctly recorded for BIR credit (W90)
**Variance Analysis**: Investigate significant variances in tariff classification or valuation

workflows.name: Customs Broker Selection, Accreditation & Performance Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics contracts broker" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews errors, delays, and complaints" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Service risk**: Poor broker performance delays clearance and incurs demurrage; mitigated by SLA and quarterly review
System Touchpoints: - Broker accreditation register; SLA tracker; performance scorecard

steps.activity: Procurement vets customs broker: BOC AMO broker accreditation (CMO 04-2014, 3-year validity; PRC license per RA 9280), PRC license, experience, references, insurance
Trade Compliance/Logistics contracts broker; defines SLA (clearance time, error rate, availability) and KPIs
Trade Compliance monitors broker performance quarterly; reviews errors, delays, and complaints; manages renewal/termination

fields.Participants: Trade Compliance, Finance, Legal, External Advisor
fields.Trigger: BOC Notice of Audit (NOA) or readiness review

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "import entries, classifications, valuations, COs, payments" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "Trade Compliance/Legal responds to BOC NOA" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "Finance settles any assessed deficiency + surcharge/interest" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
- operational: audit readiness and proactive remediation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Financial risk**: Assessment with surcharge + interest; mitigated by audit readiness and proactive remediation
System Touchpoints: - Audit repository; protest tracker; deficiency settlement

steps.activity: Trade Compliance maintains audit-ready repository: import entries, classifications, valuations, COs, payments for the 3-year post-entry-audit look-back (records retained 5 years per CMTA)
Trade Compliance/Legal responds to BOC NOA; provides documents; negotiates findings; files protest where warranted
Finance settles any assessed deficiency + surcharge/interest; books liability; updates controls

fields.Participants: Trade Compliance, Customs Broker, Legal, DC Operations
fields.Trigger: BOC alert order or hold on shipment

workflows.name: BOC Alert Order, Hold & Detention Resolution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-alert of "Customs Broker/Trade Compliance receives alert/hold notice" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation/evidence to lift hold" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "Logistics manages demurrage exposure during hold" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost/disruption risk**: Prolonged hold incurs demurrage and stockout; mitigated by rapid BOC coordination

steps.activity: Customs Broker/Trade Compliance receives alert/hold notice; coordinates with BOC to understand grounds
Trade Compliance provides documentation/evidence to lift hold; addresses mis-classification, valuation, or compliance concern
DC Operations/Logistics manages demurrage exposure during hold; Trade Compliance pursues recovery from responsible party

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Trade Compliance monitors DTI/BOC ADC/CVD orders on imported goods" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents calculation and basis" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost risk**: Unmanaged ADC/CVD inflates landed cost; mitigated by monitoring and sourcing alternatives

steps.activity: Trade Compliance monitors DTI/BOC ADC/CVD orders on imported goods (e.g., ceramic tiles from specific countries)
Procurement/Category Manager adjusts sourcing from affected countries; identifies alternative origin to avoid duty
Trade Compliance applies ADC/CVD at import entry for affected shipments; documents calculation and basis

fields.Trigger: Data sharing with BOC/customs broker or annual review

workflows.name: Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) Compliance for Customs Data Sharing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "Compliance/DPO ensures customs data sharing" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports any data incident" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy risk**: Unauthorized customs data sharing; mitigated by agreement and basis documentation
System Touchpoints: - Consent/basis management; data-sharing agreement repository; incident reporting

steps.activity: Compliance/DPO ensures customs data sharing (with BOC, broker, freight forwarder) complies with Data Privacy Act; captures consent/basis
Legal structures data-sharing agreements with brokers/forwarders; includes confidentiality and security clauses
Trade Compliance/DPO supports NPC inquiry on customs data; reports any data incident

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-register of "Trade Compliance maintains trade-compliance risk register" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates control design and operating effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews trade-compliance controls" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Untracked exposure; mitigated by risk register and CSA

steps.activity: Trade Compliance maintains trade-compliance risk register: classification, valuation, origin, broker, BOC relationship exposures
Trade Compliance performs control self-assessment; validates control design and operating effectiveness
Internal Audit reviews trade-compliance controls; reports findings to Audit Committee

fields.Trigger: Monthly close cycle — BIR-to-BOC reconciliation (import VAT, duties, BOC Official Receipts/SSDT credit documents on imports)

workflows.name: BIR-to-BOC Reconciliation (Import VAT, Duties, BCOR/SSDT on Imports)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Accountant reconciles import VAT and duty per BOC entries to AP and GL each month" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates duty/VAT per import entry matches classification and valuation in…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "reports variance trend" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reconciliation risk**: Unreconciled import taxes distort financials; mitigated by monthly reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - BOC-to-GL reconciliation; import-entry archive; variance tracker

steps.activity: Tax Accountant reconciles import VAT and duty per BOC entries to AP and GL each month
Trade Compliance validates duty/VAT per import entry matches classification and valuation in master
Finance resolves discrepancies (currency, timing, classification); books adjustments; reports variance trend

workflows.name: Trade Compliance KPI, Duty Cost & Savings Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "Trade Compliance compiles KPIs" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports duty-cost trend" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-492 (ensure controlled execution — Trade Compliance Audit, Broker Governance & ADC (PA-87.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategic risk**: Unmeasured duty cost; mitigated by quarterly KPI reporting

steps.activity: Trade Compliance compiles KPIs: clearance time, duty cost %, FTA preference utilization, broker performance, audit status
Finance quantifies duty savings vs. baseline; benchmarks landed cost by origin; reports duty-cost trend
Trade Compliance reports program effectiveness to Executive Committee; recommends sourcing/compliance enhancements
